messages.text: What are the most important signaling test capabilities for applications in Automotive?

Recommendation focus: prioritize Automotive eCall / NG eCall / hybrid eCall signaling capabilities, because the passages directly describe Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF NG eCall verification, PSAP simulation, EN 17240:2024 validation, and hybrid/NG eCall certification context using R&S CMX500 [7][13][25].
### 推薦先賣
NG eCall signaling over 4G/5G IMS networks should be the first Automotive capability to position, because CMX500 with CMX-KA098 is stated to support NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions [7].
PSAP simulation, voice transmission, data transmission, and EN 17240:2024 validation are explicitly stated for the NG eCall Automotive verification case [7].
Hybrid eCall testing should be positioned next, because EN 18052 requires multiple transmission paths and protocols so eCall reliably reaches its destination [36].
Hybrid eCall validation should cover NG eCall IP/IMS voice and data over 4G/5G plus fallback to classic CS eCall 2G/3G when coverage or service quality degrades [36].
Automotive validation should include call triggering, MSD transmission, GNSS positioning maintenance, and intelligible voice quality [36].
The listed hybrid eCall network scenarios include VoNR, VoLTE, circuit-switched fallback, handovers, degraded radio conditions, real-world mobile network condition simulation, and emulation of various network scenarios [82].
Functional tests, protocol conformity tests, and type-approval support for IVS implementing hybrid eCall and NG eCall are explicitly stated as uses of the R&S solution [25].

|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| R&S CMX500 hybrid eCall configuration | Hybrid eCall with NG eCall plus classic CS fallback paths [36][66] | CMX-B600B, CMX-ZG180, CMX-KS600B, CMX-KA180, CMX-KA110, CMX-KA401, CM-Z1MF, CMX-KA094, CMX-KA098, CMX-KA099, CMX-KF672B [66] | The hybrid minimum configuration lists CMX500-side items for EN18052:2025 hybrid eCall testing [66] | [36][66] | The source does not provide full test matrix, acceptance criteria, or complete PSAP scenario IDs [70]. |
| R&S CMX500 application / IP / IMS testing | IMS, IP services, throughput, QoS, delay, IP traffic visibility for Automotive eCall applications [67][75] | CMX-KA100, CMX-KA110, CMX-KA150 [75] | KA100 includes DNS, IMS server, FTP, HTTP, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput measurements, and web server; KA110 adds QoS, ePDG, delay measurement, and IP tune tool; KA150 provides IP traffic analysis [75] | [75] | The passages do not tie every KA100/KA110/KA150 function to a specific Automotive test case [75]. |

Automotive validation should include call triggering, MSD transmission, GNSS positioning maintenance, and intelligible voice quality [36].
The listed hybrid eCall network scenarios include VoNR, VoLTE, circuit-switched fallback, handovers, degraded radio conditions, real-world mobile network condition simulation, and emulation of various network scenarios [82].
Functional tests, protocol conformity tests, and type-approval support for IVS implementing hybrid eCall and NG eCall are explicitly stated as uses of the R&S solution [25].

Signaling test solution › 與既有知識的關係
- [[Communication of UAVs]] 已整理 UAV communication 的功能、鏈路、協定、硬體與頻段摘錄；本來源補充具體 UAV 產品例子與 [[R&S CMX500]] signaling test 配置線索。
- [[Communications on UAVs]] 只是 UAV communication / SDR link hub；本來源比該 link hub 多出可抽取的 CMX500 5G / Wi‑Fi 配置表。
- [[R&S CMX500]]、[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 與 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 已有正式產品規格與 features 來源；本來源屬於 Market 類 OneNote solution note，適合用於 UAV use-case / configuration discussion，不應取代正式 specifications 或 configuration tool。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 正式 specifications 已支撐 RF unit 400 MHz to 8000 MHz、CMX500 base unit 1201.0002K70、CMX-PB70H 1222.0676.09、CMX-B200A 1222.0747.02、CMX-B300C 1222.0801.04、CMX-B600B 1222.0953.03、CMX-KM600 1222.4013.02 等資料；本來源與這些資料一致，但用途是 UAV signaling solution 摘要。
- [[4G 5G NR WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing]] 已整理 CMX500 OBT 與 Bluetest 的 4G / 5G NR / WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing；本來源較偏向 conducted / signaling configuration 與多技術 De-sense 驗證概念，未提到 OTA chamber。

Signaling test solution › 原文未解的問題
- 來源未標示正式發布日期、作者、整理單位、客戶、專案、版本或適用地區。
- UAV 產品表未提供各產品官方 datasheet、文件版次、通訊模組型號、頻段地區限制、發射功率、頻寬、加密 / 跳頻細節或測試條件。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 5G / Wi‑Fi 配置表未標示依據的正式 configuration guide、軟體版本、license bundle、報價工具版本或 release date。
- 來源寫「配置如有疑問請與 1C PM 確認」，表示表格不應被視為最終報價或完整配置。
- 多技術 De-sense validation 只提供概念與配置合併原則，未提供測試案例、干擾模型、pass / fail limits、setup diagram、synchronization、shielding / chamber 條件或 automation flow。
- `5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100.pdf` 未擷取正文；不可引用其 anti-jamming 主張。
- `Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.pptx` 未擷取正文；不可引用其 5G private network resilience 主張。

Signaling test solution › 重點摘要
- 本來源是 OneNote 複製出的 [[UAV]] signaling test solution 筆記，raw 轉檔日期為 2026-09-17；正文未標示正式發布日期、作者、文件版次或適用客戶 / 專案。
- 來源指出無人機常使用多種通信技術，例子包含 proprietary radio / image transmission、Wi‑Fi、[[LTE]]、未來 [[5G]]、[[RTK]]、[[SATCOM]] 與 encrypted frequency-hopping radio。
- 來源以多款無人機 / UAV 產品為例整理核心通訊技術：[[DJI Mini 4 Pro]]、[[DJI Mavic 3]]、[[DJI Mavic 3 Enterprise]]、[[Parrot ANAFI Ai]]、[[XAG P100]]、[[Skydio X2E]]、[[RQ-4 Global Hawk]] 與 [[Switchblade]]。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] RF frequency range 為 **400 MHz 至 8 GHz**，可提供 [[LTE]]、[[5G]] 與 [[Wi-Fi]] UE 的單一技術 signaling test。
- 來源列出 signaling test 可包含基本 RF 量測、application layer tests 與 protocol test；基本 RF 量測項目包含 Power、Frequency、Spectrum、[[EVM]]、[[PER]] / [[BLER]]、[[MIMO]]。
- 來源列出一組 [[R&S CMX500]] 5G test configuration，包含 [[R&S CMX-PB70H]]、[[R&S CMX-B200A]]、[[R&S CMX-B300C]]、[[R&S CMX-B600B]]、[[R&S CMX-KA100]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KM600]]。
- 來源列出一組 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi test configuration，包含 WLAN signaling、WLAN TX measurement 與 WLAN ARB generator options，例如 [[R&S CMX-KS350B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS351B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS352B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS355B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS356B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS360B]]、[[R&S CMX-KM350]]、[[R&S CMX-KM351]]、[[R&S CMX-KM352]]、[[R&S CMX-KM360]]、[[R&S CMX-KW350]]、[[R&S CMX-KW351]]、[[R&S CMX-KW352]]。
- 來源指出如果 UAV 使用兩種以上通訊技術，通訊技術之間可能造成相互干擾；基於 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援多種通訊技術，可進行 De-sense validation。
- 來源對多技術整合驗證的配置原則是：software options 合併上述 5G 與 Wi‑Fi 表格，hardware 以滿足兩者中最大的 carrier aggregation 或 [[MIMO]] 作為配置。
- 來源末尾列出兩個待讀材料：本機 PDF `5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100.pdf`，以及 SharePoint 上 `Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.pptx`；正文未擷取。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

R&S CMX500 › 使用介面與 automation
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

| 介面 | 原文定位 |
|---|---|
| [[CMsquares]] | 單一 graphical user interface，web-based、responsive，支援 RF tests、functional tests、advanced signaling tests、protocol tests |
| [[R&S CMXmars]] | Message log analysis，可離線分析或在線監控 instrument messaging |
| [[R&S CMsequencer]] | Graphical scripting interface，可在 CMX500 或 Windows PC 上建立、設定與執行 test scripts |
| [[XLAPI]] | Python-based scripting interface，適合 complex scripting use cases |
| [[SCPI]] | Remote control interface，適合 simple、standardized scripting use cases |

XLAPI scripting environment：Python 3.10；script development computer 可為 Windows PC 或 CMX500；XLAPI installation package 為 **CMX-KF600X**。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 驗證範圍
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard]]：

- 驗證對象：[[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 的 [[Next Generation eCall]] functionality。
- 合作方：[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]]。
- 測試設備：[[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester。
- Software context：來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] with [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option can be effectively used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions。
- 標準：[[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 測試情境：simulating a [[PSAP]]。
- 驗證內容：NG eCall including voice and data transmission，並 validated the compliance of the implementation at both ends with EN 17240:2024。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › Regulatory transition context
同一來源提供下列背景，但未列 regulation 文件編號：

- [[eCall]] automated vehicle emergency call system introduced in 2015。
- eCall 自 2018 年起是 all new cars sold within the European Union 的 mandatory requirement。
- 來源稱 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks become obsolete，因此 emergency call systems 需要 adapted to 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。
- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] most recent regulation 定義 NG eCall will be obligatory starting **2026-01-01**。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 establishes guidelines for testing eCall systems over [[IMS]] networks, including advanced 4G LTE and 5G NR technologies。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 與既有 NGeCall / hybrid eCall 頁面的關係
- [[NGeCall over LTE]] 整理 CMW500 與 CMX500 capability lists，本頁只整理 PR 中的 Qualcomm / Snapdragon verification event。
- [[CMX500 NGeCall configuration]] 整理 configuration guide 的 mandatory / optional items，本頁不取代正式 configuration 或 quote。
- [[Hybrid eCall testing]] 以 EN 18052:2025 與 hybrid fallback 為核心；本頁聚焦 EN 17240:2024 NG eCall verification，不描述 classic CS fallback 或 EN 18052 test scope。
- [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]] 提到 EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 與 cetecom advanced certification testing；本頁來源只提 EN 17240:2024，且未說第三方 certification report。

Virtual Signalling Tester › 來源定義
[[mx844030pc-j1200]] 將 [[Virtual Signalling Tester]] 描述為 software protocol simulator / Virtual Signalling Test Solution，透過虛擬化 protocol stack，在 PC 上重現多個 protocol layers：

- [[RRC-NAS]]
- [[PDCP]]
- [[RLC]]
- [[MAC]]

來源主張它可不使用一般硬體測試儀而在 PC 上快速建立 protocol test environment；但 RF-IF configuration 仍使用 [[Anritsu MD8190A]] Universal RF Unit 與 [[MX819020A]] RF Platform。

Virtual Signalling Tester › Post-silicon testing
- 適用 [[IoT]] device 與 communication module 的 basic protocol test。
- 支援快速 functional test、regression test、sample scenario parameterization、test procedure 與 report / log display。
- 來源列出 [[5G RedCap]]、Automotive、Healthcare、Industrial IoT、Smart Cities 等應用語境。

Virtual Signalling Tester › 與 Virtual tester 的區分
[[Virtual tester]] 在 [[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 中是 R&S AI Workplace questionnaire 的 agentic workflow concept，跨 implementation、test、debug、validation。

[[Virtual Signalling Tester]] 則是 [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 中 Anritsu NR / RedCap protocol simulation and test product / solution 語彙。兩者名稱相近，但目前沒有來源支持它們是同一產品、同一架構或同一市場分類。

Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱其與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 合作，驗證 [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 上 [[Next Generation eCall]]（NG eCall）的 implementation，並稱其符合 [[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 來源說 [[eCall]] 於 2015 年導入，且自 2018 年起成為歐盟境內所有新車銷售的 mandatory requirement。
- 來源指出，隨著 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks 逐漸 obsolete，emergency call systems 需要適配到 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。
- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] 在其 most recent regulation 中定義 NG eCall 將自 **2026-01-01** 起成為 obligatory。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 建立在 IP Multimedia Subsystem（[[IMS]]）networks 上測試 eCall systems 的 guidelines，涵蓋 advanced 4G LTE 與 5G NR technologies。
- [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 被描述為 5G automotive-grade platform，支援 high-speed connectivity、advanced positioning、Vehicle-to-Everything（[[V2X]]）、multi-band [[GNSS]] navigation 與 enhanced safety。
- 來源稱驗證流程使用 [[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester，作為 NG eCall voice and data transmission 的 comprehensive testing solution。
- 來源稱測試模擬 [[PSAP]]，並驗證 implementation at both ends with the [[EN 17240]]:2024 standard。
- 來源說 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援 4G 與 5G technologies，目標是讓方案 future-proof。
- [[Juergen Meyer]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Vice President Market Segment Automotive 身分在新聞稿中引述，稱此次 collaboration 為 future emergency call services 建立 new benchmark。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option 可在 realistic network conditions 下用於 NG eCall testing。
- 來源將合作定位為 mutually validating solutions、reducing effort、accelerating time to market for mutual customers。
- Press and media contact 為 [[Patrizia Muehlbauer]]，職稱 PR Manager Products & Standard Systems。

Hybrid eCall testing › 與 NGeCall over LTE / NR-LTE 的關係
[[NGeCall over LTE]] 與 [[NGeCall over NR-LTE]] 關注 NG eCall 在 IMS / packet-switched 4G/5G 路徑上的測試支援與標準對照。[[Hybrid eCall testing]] 進一步把 NG eCall 與 classic CS eCall fallback、handover、degraded radio conditions 與 multi-path robustness 放在同一驗證範圍內。

Hybrid eCall testing › R&S solution context
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]：

- 測試方案基於 [[R&S CMX500]] radio communication tester。
- [[R&S CMX-KA09x]] updated eCall evaluation solution 支援 [[EN 18052]]:2025 與 [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026 compliance。
- [[R&S CMX-KA099]] completed [[PSAP]] test scenarios according to [[EN 18052]]:2025。
- [[R&S CMX-KA098]] completed [[PSAP]] test scenarios according to [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026。
- [[cetecom advanced]] conducted certification testing。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試目的
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]，hybrid eCall test specification [[EN 18052]] 要求 hybrid system combine different transmission paths and protocols，確保 eCall reliably reaches its destination。

來源描述的實務語境：

- 車輛使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G。
- 當 coverage 或 service quality degrades 時，車輛可 automatically fall back to available classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。
- Manufacturers 需要 validate hybrid implementations，以確保能 trigger calls、transmit [[MSD]]、maintain [[GNSS]] positioning，並提供 intelligible voice quality。

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing
[[CMX500 use-case based 5G testing]] 是 [[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]] 中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 market / solution positioning：以 use-case based approach 支援 5G eMBB、FWA、RedCap、NTN、XR 等裝置測試，而不只是一組單點工具。

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing › toolchain
來源列出的 CMX500 toolchain 包含：

- [[R&S CMsquares]]。
- [[R&S CONTEST]]。

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing › XR / application testing 線索
來源的 XR / Metaverse 章節以 [[R&S CMX500]] 連接 lab-based XR testbed：

此處只可視為簡報中的 Wi-Fi 7 / WLAN test capability 線索；實際 channel、band plan、MCS、EVM limit、DUT 條件與 test setup 需回正式文件。

CMX500 Desense Testing › 來源中的說法
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]：

- WLAN + Cellular in one box enables Interference / Desense Testing。
- against all LTE / NR bands。
- with real connections。
- Example：WiFi against all LTE/NR bands with real connections。

CMX500 Multi-SIM testing › DSDA
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，[[DSDA]]（dual SIM dual active）：

- Two TRX。
- 2 SIMs in active connection at a time。

依 [[Dual Sim Dual Active]]，Release 18 DSDA 的 3GPP / stack 背景是：

- dual-Tx / dual-Rx MUSIM UE 可同時維持兩個 [[RRC_CONNECTED]] states。
- UE 可能先連到一個 network，再連到第二個 network。
- UE 可將部分 hardware capabilities 移給第二個 network。
- hardware capability sharing 與 band conflict 可能導致 temporary capability restriction。
- Network A 是 NR，Network B 可以是 E-UTRA 或 NR。

⚠️ [[Dual Sim Dual Active]]（2026-09-24 converted；來源未標示正式日期）說 DSDA 表格列為 answering new call 時 ongoing call is released、DR-DA 才是 ongoing call is kept，但既有頁面 [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]] 說 example use case 中 call on SIM1 on hold 並可回到 SIM1。判斷：可能是 DSDA / DR-DA terminology、call service handling 與 CMX500 demo slide 的層級差異；未回查原 PDF / release note 前不裁決。

CMX500 Multi-SIM testing › Example use case
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 example use case：

1. Ongoing MT call on SIM1。
2. Incoming call received。
3. Change to call on SIM2。
4. Call on SIM1 on hold。
5. Go back to call on SIM1。

來源註明：DSDS takes longer as more signaling involved（RRC + IMS）。

CMX500 Multi-SIM testing › DSDS
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，[[DSDS]]（dual SIM dual standby）：

- One TX, 2 RX（typical）。
- 2 SIMs in standby。
- One SIM in active connection at a time。
- 可 listen for paging with 2nd RX。

依 [[Dual Sim Dual Active]]，DSDS 是 Release 17 MUSIM base feature；來源表格說當 UE 在一個 network 上通話時，另一個 network 不能接收 voice call，也不能 data transmission。Dual Receive DSDS 則可接收另一個 network 的 incoming call，但若接聽新 call，ongoing call released。

CMX500 Multi-SIM testing › Supported combinations
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 來源列出：

- 5G + 5G（DSDS / DSDA）。
- 4G + 5G（DSDS / DSDA）。
- LTE + LTE（DSDS）。
- LTE + LTE（DSDA）在不同 slide 中一處列為 supported，另一處列為 coming soon。

- 來源說 NR-LTE use cases have no impact on NR stack since a single NR connection is needed。
- DSDA can be combined with CA and NR-DC。

Recommendation focus: prioritize Automotive eCall / NG eCall / hybrid eCall signaling capabilities, because the passages directly describe Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF NG eCall verification, PSAP simulation, EN 17240:2024 validation, and hybrid/NG eCall certification context using R&S CMX500 [7][13][25].
### 推薦先賣
NG eCall signaling over 4G/5G IMS networks should be the first Automotive capability to position, because CMX500 with CMX-KA098 is stated to support NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions [7].
PSAP simulation, voice transmission, data transmission, and EN 17240:2024 validation are explicitly stated for the NG eCall Automotive verification case [7].
Hybrid eCall testing should be positioned next, because EN 18052 requires multiple transmission paths and protocols so eCall reliably reaches its destination [36].
Hybrid eCall validation should cover NG eCall IP/IMS voice and data over 4G/5G plus fallback to classic CS eCall 2G/3G when coverage or service quality degrades [36].
Automotive validation should include call triggering, MSD transmission, GNSS positioning maintenance, and intelligible voice quality [36].
The listed hybrid eCall network scenarios include VoNR, VoLTE, circuit-switched fallback, handovers, degraded radio conditions, real-world mobile network condition simulation, and emulation of various network scenarios [82].
Functional tests, protocol conformity tests, and type-approval support for IVS implementing hybrid eCall and NG eCall are explicitly stated as uses of the R&S solution [25].

| R&S CMX500 application / IP / IMS testing | IMS, IP services, throughput, QoS, delay, IP traffic visibility for Automotive eCall applications [67][75] | CMX-KA100, CMX-KA110, CMX-KA150 [75] | KA100 includes DNS, IMS server, FTP, HTTP, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput measurements, and web server; KA110 adds QoS, ePDG, delay measurement, and IP tune tool; KA150 provides IP traffic analysis [75] | [75] | The passages do not tie every KA100/KA110/KA150 function to a specific Automotive test case [75]. |

### 限制
The NG eCall verification source is a press-release-level source, not an EN 17240:2024 standard summary, conformance test plan, or certification report [56].
The hybrid eCall certification source does not provide certificate number, test dates, full acceptance criteria, or full PSAP scenario coverage [70].
